== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will use this skill on recharge. They do not reserve its use for targets using a stance.

==Notes==
* [[Furious Axe]] can help meet the adrenaline cost against an opponent with a blocking stance. 
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.

== Trivia ==
* The axe depicted on the [[skill icon]] resembles a [[Crude Axe (Canthan)|Canthan Crude Axe]].
* The animation of this skill resembles a glowing [[Gemstone Axe]].
